name: Aethelgard Royal OS
description: A bespoke Classic Royal retro mobile phone operating system in black, ivory white, and skinny champagne tones. Features an iPod-style click-wheel music player, distraction-free YouTube, Samsung Notes, Files, Gallery, WhatsApp, Google Gemini AI, vintage Camera, Horology Clock, Perpetual Calendar, Mechanical Calculator, ProLearner Academy, and a permanent 13th app slot.
